name: Murdoch Senate Bursary
summary: $3,000 over two semesters for new full-time Murdoch undergraduates in financial or personal hardship.
key: $3,000, paid as $1,500 in the semester you are awarded and $1,500 the next.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, NZ citizen or humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolled in your first undergraduate course at Murdoch, full-time (at least 9 credit points).
how: Complete the online application and upload evidence of hardship.

evidence.quote: $1,500 in the semester you are awarded
be in financial and/or personal hardship
